metadata.title: Alexandrov's theorem in the anti-Gaussian space: A Reilly-formula approach
metadata.abstract: We give an alternative proof of Alexandrov's theorem about constant weighted mean curvature hypersurfaces in the anti-Gaussian space, due to the authors and Johne-Silini independently, via a Reilly-type formula approach. Moreover, we establish a sharp Heintze-Karcher-type inequality for hypersurfaces in manifolds with a generalized substatic condition, together with its rigidity in Euclidean space with density.

analysis.workSummary: 用 Reilly 型公式重证反高斯空间的加权常平均曲率 Alexandrov 定理，并推广 Heintze–Karcher 型不等式。
techniques: Reilly 型公式与广义次静态条件
analysis.breakthrough: 在广义次静态流形建立尖锐积分不等式，并研究带密度欧氏空间的等号刚性。
analysis.limitations: Alexandrov 结论的替代证明针对既有定理，推广依赖广义次静态条件。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
